rationale: In 2026 IndyCar qualifying, Alex Palou has 6 poles (and was fastest at Markham street course before Q2 brush), Felix Rosenqvist won poles at Long Beach street circuit and Portland (Aug 9), Scott McLaughlin qualified P3 at Markham street circuit, Kyle Kirkwood is #2 in standings/street winner, and Andretti Honda's Will Power qualified P3 (+0.030s) at Portland.
